question.text: Tax efficiency as an investment objective aims at:

answer.text: Optimising POST-tax returns using legal tax-efficient instruments

explanation.text: The Logic: Tax efficiency = lawful optimisation of post-tax return. The Trap: Evasion is illegal; mere deduction hunting misses the goal. Cross-Exam Context: Same theme in X-B, XVII. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use capital-gains harvesting and tax-loss harvesting thoughtfully.
